# Third-Party Notices

The whale ornament shipped with this package (assets/decorations/whale/whale-frames.png
plus its decoration.json) is derived from the DeepSeek wordmark in the
[deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) repository
(`website/public/wordmark.svg`), licensed under the MIT License. The derivative
frames re-color the mark to the DeepSeek brand blue and compose a four-frame
spout animation; no other third-party material is included.

The OUO Neko pet assets shipped with this package (`assets/ouo-neko/`: pet.json,
spritesheet.webp and the preview GIFs) are authored by Pessimist0906 and are
distributed under the MIT License below. Provenance: the v2 pet manifest declares
`author: Pessimist0906` and `license: MIT` (fail-closed contract), and the
assets were contributed under that author statement recorded in
[PR #1118](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/pull/1118). No separate public
upstream repository was available at integration time; this manifest declaration
and contribution record are the author statement for this distribution.

## Miku pet (assets/miku/)

The Miku pet assets shipped with this repository (`assets/miku/`: pet.json,
the thumb/ frame sequences and the preview) are authored by stushansusu
(涂山苏苏) and contributed under the MIT License below; provenance:
[PR #1031](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/pull/1031) (the former
dsh-miku-pet plugin, whose gameplay this package's gameplay block
generalizes). The pet.json manifest declares `author: stushansusu (涂山苏苏)`
and `license: MIT` (fail-closed contract).

Hatsune Miku (初音ミク) is a character whose name, image, and likeness are
owned by Crypton Future Media, INC. The miku assets are fan artwork depicting
the character; character usage is governed by the Piapro Character License
(official terms: https://piapro.net/piapro/en/license/pcl.html — Japanese:
https://piapro.net/piapro/license/pcl.html). Review those terms before
redistributing or using these assets; obtain the appropriate rights from
Crypton Future Media where the license conditions are not met. Only the
contributor's original artwork is claimed here — no official illustrations,
logos, or licensed runtimes from Crypton Future Media are included.

## Doro pet (assets/doro/)

The Doro pet assets shipped with this repository (`assets/doro/`: pet.json, the
`thumb/` frame sequences and the preview assets) are contributed by stushansusu
under the MIT License below; the manifest declares `author: 11726` and
`license: MIT` (fail-closed contract). Provenance:
[PR #1630](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/pull/1630).

Doro (朵拉) is an unofficial, fan-made meme derivative of Dorothy (桃乐丝), a

promoted as 《胜利女神：新的希望》). The character design, name, likeness and

is not affiliated with or endorsed by SHIFT UP, and it claims no rights to the

them or use them commercially, and do not present them as official. Only the
contributor's original frame artwork is covered by the MIT License below; no
official illustrations, logos, voice recordings or other licensed material from
SHIFT UP is included.

## Jyn-Loli pet (assets/jyn-loli/)

The Jyn-Loli pet assets shipped with this repository (`assets/jyn-loli/`: pet.json,
the `thumb/` frame sequences, the asset README and the preview GIFs) are contributed
by stushansusu (涂山苏苏) under the MIT License below; the manifest declares
`author: 11726` and `license: MIT` (fail-closed contract). `11726` and stushansusu
are two signatures of the same author — every pet.json on this character line records
`11726` (jyn, jyn-foxtail and doro as well), while this file and the README built-in
pet table credit the GitHub account — the mapping the Doro section above already
records.

The character is 鲸鱼娘 (whale girl), the unofficial fan character line this
repository already ships as `assets/jyn` and `assets/jyn-foxtail`. It is a fan
interpretation of the DeepSeek whale mark: the DeepSeek name and the whale mark
belong to DeepSeek. This is fan artwork — not official, not affiliated with or
endorsed by DeepSeek — and it claims no rights to the character. The assets are for
personal, non-commercial use only: do not sell them, do not use them commercially,
and do not present them as official.

Review that position before redistributing or using these assets, and obtain the
appropriate rights from DeepSeek where the conditions above are not met — the same
terms the Miku section above states for the character it covers.

The illustration every frame is generated from is an AI-generated, pre-cut
1184 x 1920 RGBA PNG supplied by the author (visible content bounding box
1043 x 1774): the author states DeepSeek as the generator. The package's frames were
then produced from that illustration with MiniMax H3 (fl2va image-to-video) on the
author's local ComfyUI, 73 frames at 24 fps per track, the same illustration fed as
both the first and the last frame. Unlike the Jyn-Q source, that PNG carries no PNG
text chunk at all — no XMP and no TC260 AIGC label — so the generator attribution
here is the author's statement rather than file metadata. No third-party artwork,
official illustration, logo, voice recording or licensed runtime is included; only
the contributor's own contribution — the generated frame sequences, the manifest,
the asset README and the previews — is covered by the MIT License below.

## deep-chan pet (assets/deep-chan/)

The deep-chan pet assets in this directory (`assets/deep-chan/`: `pet.json`, the
spritesheet, and the preview GIFs) are contributed by **Daizhdd**. The manifest
declares `author: Daizhdd` and `license: Personal-Use-Only`.

deep酱 (deep-chan) is an unofficial, fan-made derivative of the DeepSeek whale
girl (鲸鱼娘). The character design, name, likeness and all related rights belong
to the original author(s) and to DeepSeek. This is fan artwork: it is not official
and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek, and it claims no rights to the
character. The assets are for personal, non-commercial use only — do not sell them
or use them commercially, and do not present them as official.

Artwork provenance: the character was designed by the contributor with AI
assistance. The frames were then cut, given secondary motion (breathing, sway,
bob), and packed into the sprite2d atlas by a script; every frame in
`spritesheet.webp` is derived from the contributor's own artwork. No official
illustrations, logos, voice recordings or any other licensed material is included,
and no third-party artwork was used as a source.

These assets are **not** covered by the MIT License of this repository, nor by any
license text above: the manifest's `license` field (`Personal-Use-Only`) governs
them.
